scope: Terms appearing in the syllabus wording of two or more of the five AS topics. Cross-topic recurrence is the trigger for RS-08, not importance.
definitions: Deliberately empty. Canonical definitions are authored at pipeline Stage 10 as claims, not invented here.

terms.canonical_definition: In any costing context, contribution means selling price per unit minus variable cost per unit: the amount each unit sold contributes towards the fixed costs of the period, and towards profit once those fixed costs are covered.
terms.rule: RS-08 - one canonical definition inherited everywhere unless a documented subject reason requires a contextual variation.
terms.disambiguation: HOMONYM - do NOT inherit one definition. Topic 5.4 uses the costing term (selling price minus variable cost). Topics 2.3 and 4.1 use the ordinary sense ('the contribution of managers to business performance', 'the contribution of operations to added value'). RS-08 requires a documented contextual variation here.

contextual_variation.documented_reason: RS-08. The word carries two unrelated senses in this syllabus and inheriting one would introduce an error in whichever topic did not own it.

costing_sense.definition: Selling price per unit minus variable cost per unit. A calculated money figure.

ordinary_sense.definition: The part something or someone plays in producing a result, as in the contribution of managers to business performance. No calculation is implied and no formula applies.
ordinary_sense.authoring_rule: Where the ordinary sense is meant, prefer a plainer word - the part played, the effect of, the role of - so the costing sense is never suggested by accident.

contextual_variation.learner_warning: A learner who has met the costing formula will try to apply it in topic 2.3 or 4.1. Say plainly, in those topics, that the word is being used in its everyday sense there.
contextual_variation.settled_by: Vitalis to confirm; drafted 2026-09-08 during Stage 10 authoring of topic 5.4.
